_source: nflfastR win probability model (public). Deltas are approximate; calibrate against Phase 0 data.
_unit: win probability delta for the home team, signed. Positive = home improves.

SCORING_PLAY:close.note: Scoring play when margin <= 7 pts. Whichever team scored, swing is large.

SCORING_PLAY:blowout.note: Scoring play when margin > 14 pts. Diminishing returns.

TURNOVER.note: Fumble or interception. Direction depends on possession context (see detector).

INJURY.note: Starter injury. Magnitude depends heavily on player importance — not modeled yet.
